title: Glossary of Constitutional and Simulation Terms
summary: Definitions of the terms used throughout the public record.

table.caption: Glossary
rows: The LLM-backed legal adjudicator operating under published rules and precedent.
The elected 600-seat legislature controlling the releases and uses of cosmic resources.
A frontier laboratory programme of self-expanding interstellar probes.
A set of Assembly seats controlled and voted together by one player.
The Speaker and proportional party deputies who administer floor business.
Seven-seat protector of founding constitutional bargains and institutional holdings.
Aligned superintelligent delegates deliberating on moral questions and administering Deferral allocations.
Released resources assigned in equal individual claims.
The International Agreement on Advanced AI Governance (2039).
The temporary constitutional rules adopted for 2040–2060.
The negotiating bloc of states without their own Council seat.
Accessible extra-solar-system matter-energy rights, initially represented by 100 units.
The fraction of the unallocated pool authorised in a term.
Released rights held for generations born after 2040.
One real month, representing ten years of simulated history.
The five-member Charter Review Tribunal reviewing legal decisions.
The moderator-operated system producing coherent consequences of player decisions.
